text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 18, 2024) for 5 Jansusie Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 18, 2024) for 5 Jansusie Road, Folder Number 24 218384 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
